entries.title: NYSE Euronext Statement on Closure of U.S. Markets on Monday Oct. 29 and Pending Confirmation on Tuesday, Oct. 30, 2012
entries.location: https://www.aol.com/news/2012-10-28-nyse-euronext-statement-on-closure-of-us-markets-o.html (mirror of the 28 October 2012 release; the original nyse.com page is no longer online; also https://www.marktpuls.ch/artikel/permalink/5413)
entries.notes: Dated New York, 28 October 2012: the exchange's own statement that its US markets would be closed on Monday 29 October 2012 because of Hurricane Sandy. The 29 October follow-up (mirror https://www.marktpuls.ch/artikel/permalink/5531) extended the closure to Tuesday 30 October, and the 30 October statement (https://mondovisione.com/news/nyse-euronext-statement-on-opening-of-us-markets-on-wednesday-oct-31-2012-20121030/) announced a normal 9:30 a.m. open on 31 October. NYSE Euronext's October 2012 volume release (https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2012/NYSE-Euronext-Announces-Trading-Volumes-for-October-2012/default.aspx) counts 21 US trading days in the month, two fewer than scheduled.

entries.title: NASDAQ Composite Index (NASDAQCOM), daily observations
entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), data from Nasdaq OMX Group
entries.notes: Day-level cross-check of US equity trading days: FRED lists every weekday and leaves the value blank on every day with no session. For every year from 2008 through 12 October 2026 the blank weekdays equal the NYSE's scheduled weekday closures plus exactly the four unscheduled closures (29-30 October 2012, 5 December 2018, 9 January 2025) and no trading day is missing, so no other unscheduled full-day closure occurred. One known artifact: the series prints a value on Good Friday 2019-04-19, when the markets were closed (the S&P 500 series is blank that day). An index series cannot show an early close.

entries.title: S&P 500 (SP500), daily observations
entries.publisher: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), data from S&P Dow Jones Indices
entries.notes: Second, independent index series over FRED's ten-year window; its blank weekdays equal the NYSE's weekday closures exactly, including Good Friday 2019 where the Nasdaq series has its artifact.
